title: Through the shop window
prompt: The inside of the same small potion shop seen from behind the counter, looking out through the big front window at the street at dusk: a doorstep in front of the shop where a visitor can stand, lamps lit across the way, the window frame and the counter edge closing the picture.
story: The first-person scene: a visitor seen through the store window, a wand in one hand (the hand is added in-engine). Leave the doorstep empty.
